marta (PM): Quick sync — ACME pilot target: 2026-04-01. We need alignment on minimal launch scope + cross-team gating. Primary risks: runtime KV cache changes, KMS integration for tenant keys, and staging prewarm slots. Who can own each gate?

alex (Eng): I can own the runtime integration work but need a clear acceptance checklist from product for the MVP behaviors. Are we ok with a degraded flow (no tenant KMS) for initial canary?

sam (Runtime): Degraded flow OK *only* if we have fallback that isolates tenant data and logs an audit event. Performance note: the new KV change may add ~8ms p95 unless batching is tuned. Need time to test with ACME token distribution.

jess (Infra): Prewarm slots: we have two options — reserved Dedicated pool or burstable Hosted pool. Dedicated takes a week to provision and an infra ticket. Burstable needs autoscale policy tweaks and quota increase request to cloud, ~3 days. Which direction?

marta (PM): Prefer burstable for speed, but if ACME requires sustained throughput we should reserve later. Can we do burstable now and convert to dedicated if we hit 70% sustained over 48h?

casey (SRE): That SLA trigger is doable. We'll monitor and create an alert: `alert when sustained_utilization > 70% for 2h` and a runbook to escalate. Need confirmation on who approves conversion (finance + product).

li (Security): KMS path: customer-managed keys require HSM onboarding + key rotation policy review. That gating is independent of runtime perf, and we need at least one security review slot — earliest availability is 2026-03-18. If you want canary without CMK, we require a documented data-separation design and encrypted-in-transit proof.

alex (Eng): For the acceptance checklist, propose: 1) end-to-end generation with prefix cache on ACME test tenant, 2) fallback flow validated with simulated KMS failure, 3) latency p95 < 120ms in staging, 4) canary rollback flag. Thoughts?

marta (PM): Looks good. Add: 5) security checklist sign-off (li) and 6) infra prewarm config applied (jess).

sam (Runtime): I'll run a perf matrix and post results by EOD Fri. If p95 is above target, we can try adaptive batching + reduce KV lookups for short prompts.

jess (Infra): I'll spin up burstable pool and open the quota request today. Ticket: INFRA-4321. ETA for pool ready: 48h after quota approval.

li (Security): I'll slot the review — need the design doc + threat model by Thu noon. If you can't finish, we can scope a temporary mitigations list.

marta (PM): Action items summarized:
- alex: delivery plan + rollback flag (due Thu COB)
- sam: perf matrix + tuning options (due Fri EOD)
- jess: open INFRA-4321 + provision burstable pool (start today)
- li: security review slot request (waiting on design doc)
- casey: alert and runbook for conversion trigger

Please respond with "ack" on your line if you accept the ownership and deadlines.

alex (Eng): ack

sam (Runtime): ack — will post perf table `/perf/results` in this thread

jess (Infra): ack — opened INFRA-4321, linked below.

deploy-bot: Note: maintenance window 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC, canary deploys blocked during window :no_entry_sign:

marta (PM): Thanks — small ask: can we avoid scheduling the ACME canary during that maintenance window? If quota or provisioning delays push us, we should reschedule.

casey (SRE): We'll flag the window in the runbook. If provisioning completes earlier we can slide the canary earlier.

li (Security): Quick Q: Does the design doc include key-rotation sequence for tenant CMKs? If not add it to the doc.

alex (Eng): will add rotation steps and a short appendix for rollback.

marta (PM): Great. I'll consolidate into a launch checklist and post a follow-up with concrete dates after Thursday's progress updates. :thumbsup:

sam (Runtime): one more note — if we need sub-100ms p95 we should lock batching params before provisioning. I'll include recommended defaults in the perf post.

jess (Infra): INFRA-4321 link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4321

marta (PM): Thanks team. Closing for now — will re-open if blockers surface.
thread_text_short: Cross-team sync about ACME pilot scope, owner ack and action items for runtime, infra, security, SRE (prewarm vs dedicated, KMS gating, perf targets).
